entries.summary: Core setup canary failed before the documented route reached execution.
entries.removal_condition: Retire after three consecutive clean-cache setup canaries pass.

entries.summary: Fixture-focused verification failed before the deterministic fixture could be exercised.
entries.removal_condition: Retire after the fixture negative control remains green in three accepted runs.

entries.summary: The smoke command referenced an unavailable benchmark runner.
entries.removal_condition: Retire when the canonical smoke command and catalog are removed together.

entries.summary: Python or uv could not create a usable temporary workspace.
entries.removal_condition: Retire after supported clean-cache environments pass the doctor canary.

entries.summary: Developer guidance contained contradictory canonical commands and paths.

prevention_seam.anchor: This runbook describes the current, repository-owned verification commands.

entries.removal_condition: Retire when the runbook is superseded by an approved canonical contract.

entries.summary: Orientation consumed an oversized or contradictory context surface.
entries.removal_condition: Retire when bounded task-context retrieval is replaced by an approved contract.
